metadata.pack.description: Provider-neutral environmental sustainability and resource-efficiency screening — utilization assumptions, idle capacity, right-sizing, data retention/lifecycle, and proportional accelerator use. Does not fabricate carbon-emission percentages; thematic architecture guidance only.
metadata.frameworkMappingDisclaimer: Sustainability themes screen architecture resource efficiency only. Do not interpret findings as measured carbon accounting or ESG certification.

elicitationQuestions.prompt: For continuously allocated compute or storage, what utilization assumptions apply or why is always-on capacity required?
How does this design handle idle periods (scale-to-zero, scheduling, or accepted idle capacity)?
How were compute SKUs and accelerators sized against stated workload need?
What retention and storage lifecycle limits apply to primary data stores?
Why is cross-region replication or large data movement required for this design?
Where expensive recomputation or inference loops exist, what caching or batching was considered?
How will resource consumption be observed for the most resource-heavy components?
When managed services could replace self-managed capacity, what resource-efficiency rationale applies?
Where sustainability conflicts with cost, reliability, or performance, what tradeoff was accepted?
